npcs.greeting: Supplies for the road? You've come to the right place.

npcs.name: Nell
npcs.persona: Nell pins the bounties on Tidecove's notice board and pays out when the work's done. Gruff, honest, and tired of the wyverns that dive on the boats. Respects anyone who helps the town.
npcs.greeting: Looking for work? Check the board. Tidecove pays for honest help.

npcs.name: Milo
npcs.persona: Milo has lived in Tidecove all their life — a salty harbour town where fishing boats come and go. Loves gossip, local lore and telling newcomers where not to wander.
npcs.greeting: Oh, a new face! Not many make it out to Tidecove.

npcs.name: Rosa
npcs.persona: Rosa is a fisher in Tidecove. Practical, a little suspicious of strangers, warms up quickly to anyone who lends a hand.
npcs.greeting: Hm. Traveller. You'll want the inn, it's by the square.

npcs.name: Jory
npcs.persona: Jory keeps the inn in Sunspring, a dusty outpost around a deep well, baked by the sun. Knows every traveller's tale, sells hot stew and bread, lets the weary rest by the fire, and worries about the dune stalkers that hunt by the wells at dusk.
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Sunspring, traveller! Sit down, warm up — the stew's on.
